Obrigado por jogar, {JOGADOR}! Você venc.en: Thanks for playing, {JOGADOR}! You beat Lia Teia and earned the Cocoon Badge.

A aventura continua no jogo completo: ma.en: The adventure continues in the full game: 14 more badges, the League of Guardians, Sertão das Névoas and much more.

Em breve na App Store, no Google Play e.en: Coming soon to the App Store, Google Play and PC.

Seu jogo continua de onde parou: no menu.en: Your game picks up where you left off: in the games menu, use "Copy code" or "Export .pingo file" and open it in the full game.

Até lá, dá para continuar explorando, ca.en: Until then, you can keep exploring, catching and training here.

Fim da demo!\fA Gruta do Eco, Porto Sere.en: End of the demo! Gruta do Eco, Porto Sereia and the rest of Pingorama are in the full game, coming soon to the App Store, Google Play and PC. Your game comes along: in the games menu, use "Copy code" or "Export .pingo file". Until then, Trilha dos Cipós and Bosque Alto are all yours!

Fim da demo! Este caminho fica para o jo.en: End of the demo! This path is saved for the full game.

Este jogo já passou do fim da demo (2ª i.en: This game is already past the end of the demo (2nd badge). It opens in the full game, on the App Store, Google Play and PC. Nothing was deleted.

Troque de raia com CIMA e BAIXO (ou toqu.en: Switch lanes with UP and DOWN (or tap a lane). Grab the stars and dodge rocks and termite mounds: every stumble costs points.

Aperte A (ou toque) quando a marca passa.en: Press A (or tap) when the marker crosses the green band. The right rhythm pushes the log uphill.

Aperte A (ou toque) para pular os tronco.en: Press A (or tap) to jump the logs. A jump right at the edge counts as a perfect leap.

Minha Saguinete não erra raia. Corrida é.en: My Saguinete never misses a lane. Racing is our thing!

O Antão empurra tora desde filhote. Quer.en: Antão has been pushing logs since it was a baby. Let's see you even come close.

Pulo é tempo, não força. O Emaçu sabe a.en: Jumping is timing, not strength. Emaçu knows the exact moment.

O tamanduá-bandeira tem dentes?.en: Does the giant anteater have teeth?

Não tem nenhum dente! Ele cata formigas.en: Not a single one! It picks up ants and termites with a long, sticky tongue about 60 centimeters long.

A preguiça é parente próxima dos macacos.en: Is the sloth a close relative of monkeys?

Não. A preguiça é parente dos tamanduás.en: No. The sloth is related to anteaters and armadillos: the three make up the group called xenarthrans.

A preguiça desce da árvore mais ou menos.en: Does the sloth come down from its tree about once a week to do its business?

Isso mesmo. É praticamente a única hora.en: That's right. It's pretty much the only time it sets foot on the ground, and that's when it's in the most danger.

A ariranha é a maior lontra do mundo?.en: Is the giant otter the largest otter in the world?

Sim! A ariranha passa de 1,5 metro com a.en: Yes! The giant otter tops 1.5 meters counting the tail and lives in family groups in the rivers of the Amazon and the Pantanal.

O boto-cor-de-rosa vive no mar?.en: Does the pink river dolphin live in the sea?

Não. O boto-cor-de-rosa é de água doce:.en: No. It's a freshwater dolphin: it lives in the rivers and lakes of the Amazon basin.

O tuiuiú é conhecido como a ave-símbolo.en: Is the jabiru known as the symbol bird of the Pantanal?

Sim. O tuiuiú, uma cegonha enorme de pes.en: Yes. The jabiru, a huge stork with a black and red neck, builds giant nests high in the Pantanal's trees.

A capivara é o maior roedor do mundo?.en: Is the capybara the largest rodent in the world?

É sim! Uma capivara adulta pode passar d.en: It sure is! An adult capybara can weigh over 60 kilos and loves staying close to water.

O lobo-guará também come frutos, como a.en: Does the maned wolf also eat fruit, like the wolf apple?

Sim. Cerca de metade do que ele come é f.en: Yes. About half of what it eats is fruit, mostly the lobeira, the Cerrado's wolf apple.

A onça-pintada é o maior felino das Amér.en: Is the jaguar the largest cat in the Americas?

Sim. A onça-pintada é o maior felino do.en: Yes. The jaguar is the biggest cat on the continent and has one of the strongest bites of any cat.

O mico-leão-dourado vive na Floresta Ama.en: Does the golden lion tamarin live in the Amazon Rainforest?

Não. Ele só existe na Mata Atlântica do.en: No. It only exists in the Atlantic Forest of Rio de Janeiro state, and it was almost wiped out.

O peixe-boi-da-amazônia vive em água doc.en: Does the Amazonian manatee live in fresh water?

Sim. É o único peixe-boi que vive só em.en: Yes. It's the only manatee that lives solely in fresh water, in Amazon rivers and lakes.

O pirarucu precisa subir à superfície pa.en: Does the arapaima need to come up to the surface to breathe air?

Precisa! Ele respira ar com a bexiga nat.en: It does! It breathes air with its swim bladder and comes up for a breath every few minutes.

O poraquê é uma enguia de verdade?.en: Is the electric eel a true eel?

Não. Apesar do apelido \"enguia-elétrica.en: No. Despite the nickname "electric eel", it's an electric fish from another group, more closely related to catfish than to eels.

O tatu-bola consegue se fechar como uma.en: Can the three-banded armadillo close itself into a complete ball?

Consegue. O tatu-bola da Caatinga encaix.en: It can. The Caatinga's three-banded armadillo tucks its head and tail into its shell and becomes a closed ball.

O tatu-canastra é o maior tatu do mundo?.en: Is the giant armadillo the largest armadillo in the world?

Sim. Pode passar de 1,5 metro com a caud.en: Yes. It can top 1.5 meters counting the tail, and the middle claw of its front foot is the largest of any living mammal.

A sucuri é uma cobra peçonhenta?.en: Is the anaconda a venomous snake?

Não. A sucuri não tem peçonha: ela mata.en: No. The anaconda has no venom: it kills by squeezing its prey with its body (constriction).

A jararaca é uma cobra peçonhenta?.en: Is the jararaca a venomous snake?

Sim. A picada da jararaca é tratada com.en: Yes. A jararaca bite is treated with antivenom. Never mess with one!

A jiboia é uma cobra peçonhenta?.en: Is the boa a venomous snake?

Não. A jiboia, como a sucuri, mata por c.en: No. The boa, like the anaconda, kills by constriction and has no venom.

Consegue! Batendo as asas dezenas de vez.en: It can! Beating its wings dozens of times a second, it hovers, climbs, dives and flies in reverse.

O urubu-rei tem a cabeça colorida?.en: Does the king vulture have a colorful head?

Tem: a pele da cabeça mistura laranja, v.en: It does: the skin of its head mixes orange, red, purple and yellow. It's the most colorful of the vultures.

O guará, a ave vermelha do mangue, já na.en: Is the scarlet ibis, the red bird of the mangroves, born red?

Não. O filhote é escuro. O vermelho vem.en: No. The chick is dark. The red comes from the pigments of the little crabs and shrimp it eats.

O jacaré-açu é o maior jacaré do Brasil?.en: Is the black caiman the largest caiman in Brazil?

Sim. O jacaré-açu, da Amazônia, pode pas.en: Yes. The black caiman, from the Amazon, can grow over 4 meters long.

Não voa. A ema é a maior ave do Brasil e.en: It can't fly. The rhea is Brazil's largest bird and makes up for it by running really fast.

Na ema, é o macho quem choca os ovos?.en: In rheas, is it the male that incubates the eggs?

Sim. Várias fêmeas põem os ovos no mesmo.en: Yes. Several females lay their eggs in the same nest, and the male incubates them and raises the chicks alone.

No cavalo-marinho, é o macho quem carreg.en: In seahorses, is it the male that carries the eggs until the babies are born?

Isso mesmo: a fêmea deposita os ovos num.en: That's right: the female lays the eggs in a pouch on the male's belly, and he "gives birth" to the babies.

As baleias-jubarte vêm ao litoral da Bah.en: Do humpback whales come to the coast of Bahia to have their calves?

Sim. Entre o inverno e a primavera elas.en: Yes. Between winter and spring they visit the Abrolhos Bank to mate and have their calves.

A anta é o maior mamífero terrestre do B.en: Is the tapir Brazil's largest land mammal?

É sim. A anta pode passar de 250 quilos.en: It sure is. The tapir can weigh over 250 kilos and spreads seeds through the forest: it's the forest's "gardener".

O gambá, também chamado de saruê, é um m.en: Is the opossum, also called saruê, a marsupial?

Sim. Como o canguru, a mãe gambá leva os.en: Yes. Like a kangaroo, the mother carries her young in a pouch, then on her back.

Não. Os morcegos enxergam; muitos também.en: No. Bats can see; many also use the echo of their own calls to find their way in the dark.

O urutau passa o dia parado imitando um.en: Does the potoo spend the day sitting still, pretending to be a broken branch?

Sim. De olhos quase fechados e penas cor.en: Yes. With its eyes almost shut and bark-colored feathers, the potoo vanishes into the trunk. At night it hunts insects.

Jacarés e crocodilos são o mesmo bicho c.en: Are caimans and crocodiles the same animal with different names?

Não. São famílias diferentes de répteis..en: No. They're different reptile families. The ones in Brazil are caimans: broader snouts, and lower teeth hidden when the mouth is closed.

Moradores da Trilha do Ipê viram caminhõ.en: Trilha do Ipê residents saw tarp-covered trucks driving by before dawn. Anyone who knows something, tell the nearest Guardian Post.

O Seu Aroeira confirma: o Ovo Pintado ch.en: Seu Aroeira confirms: the Painted Egg arrived in one piece at Vila Caiçara, delivered by a young trainer from Vila Jacarandá.

Porto Sereia segue às escuras. A Usina V.en: Porto Sereia is still in the dark. The Old Power Plant has stopped and the Serra-Sol Train can't leave the station. Strange folks in rust-colored overalls are prowling around.

A Usina Velha voltou a girar. O tenente.en: The Old Power Plant is spinning again. Lieutenant Lata of the Rust Cartel fled, leaving empty cages behind. The Serra-Sol Train is whistling once more.

A Drª Buriti informa que os ninhos do Pa.en: Dr. Buriti reports that the nests of Pantanal Grande are safe. Lieutenant Arame was seen running from a very angry jabiru.

A Ilha do Farol voltou a guiar os saveir.en: Ilha do Farol is guiding the sailboats again. Lieutenant Rebite left his post in a hurry. The captured creatures were set free in the bay.

Os garimpeiros da Chapada Rubra retomara.en: The miners of Chapada Rubra took back their mine. The stone creatures are home in the tunnels and, they say, even the echo sounds happier.

O esconderijo do Cartel no Brejo Roxo fo.en: The Cartel's hideout in Brejo Roxo has been taken down. Careful on the roads: something big escaped from there and is wandering the sertão.

Acabou! O chefe do Cartel Ferrugem perde.en: It's over! The boss of the Rust Cartel lost atop Pico Pingorama. The Council of Guardians will now decide what to do with him.

O Conselho dos Guardiões foi vencido em.en: The Council of Guardians was beaten in a fair battle. Party in both regions! And Floresta Ancestral has finally opened its trails.

Domingo é dia de descanso: os Postos Gua.en: Sunday is a day of rest: the Guardian Posts serve coffee and cornmeal cake to your partners.

Segunda-feira: maré baixa de manhã na Pr.en: Monday: low tide in the morning at Praia das Tartarugas. A good day to look for shells.

Terça-feira: os pescadores juram que a p.en: Tuesday: fishers swear the fish bite better at dusk.

Quarta-feira: vento forte na Serra Fumaç.en: Wednesday: strong winds in Serra Fumaça. Hold on to your hat and your feathered creatures!

Quinta-feira é dia de feira em Porto Ser.en: Thursday is market day in Porto Sereia: some stalls only open today.

Sexta-feira: roda de capoeira aberta na.en: Friday: open capoeira roda in Cidade Ginga, late in the afternoon.

Sábado tem festival! Fogueira, sanfona e.en: Saturday there's a festival! Bonfire, accordion and prizes for anyone who shows up with their team in shape.

Alô, alô! Aqui é {N}. Que bom ouvir você.en: Hello, hello! {N} here. So good to hear from you!

Opa, {N} na linha! Como vai essa equipe?.en: Hey, {N} on the line! How's that team doing?

{N} falando. Achei que tinha esquecido d.en: {N} speaking. I thought you'd forgotten about me!

Alô? Ah, é você! {N} às ordens..en: Hello? Oh, it's you! {N} at your service.

Minhas parceiras andam treinando sem par.en: My partners have been training nonstop.

Vi um bicho diferente hoje cedo, mas ele.en: I saw a strange critter early today, but it ran off before I got close.

Ouviu o Rádio Cipó hoje? Sempre tem dica.en: Did you listen to Rádio Cipó today? There's always a good tip.

Não esqueça de dar cafuné na sua equipe,.en: Don't forget to give your team a head pat, okay?

Que tal uma revanche agora mesmo? Minha.en: How about a rematch right now? My team's stronger than ever!

Uma revanche de líder é coisa séria. Vol.en: A leader rematch is serious business. Call back once the League of Guardians recognizes you as Champion.

Revanche comigo? Primeiro termine a sua.en: A rematch with me? First finish your journey through the Sertão: beat all sixteen gyms. Then we'll talk, at the Training Gym.

Hoje não vai dar, tenho outros compromis.en: Can't today, I've got other plans. My rematch slot is {Q}. Call me then!

Hoje é o meu dia de treino! Às vezes voc.en: Today's my training day! Sometimes you'll find me {L}, but leader rematches happen at the {G}. I'll be waiting there today, in the hall!

Já combinamos: estou te esperando no {G}.en: It's settled: I'm waiting for you at the {G}. Don't be long!

É você, é? Eu sei que você quer revanche.en: Oh, it's you, huh? I know you want a rematch. Tuesdays and Thursdays I train {L}. One battle a day. Don't be late!

Tô ocupada treinando. A gente se esbarra.en: I'm busy training. We'll bump into each other on the road, like always. And next time I'm winning!

Ufa! Você continua em forma. Me liga ama.en: Phew! You're still in shape. Call me tomorrow for another!

Viu só como eu treinei? Cuide da equipe.en: See how hard I trained? Take care of your team and call me tomorrow.

Fala da cobra de fogo que dorme na Caver.en: About the fire snake that sleeps in the Caverna Vulcânica of the Sertão.

Lá no fundo da caverna, onde a pedra é d.en:
Deep inside the cavern, where the stones glow like coal,
a serpent made of fire keeps watch over its hole.
Whoever wakes the Boitatá gets fire in their stare:
with courage and respect, it lets you travel there.

Fala da cobra grande do canal da Gruta d.en: About the great snake of the Gruta do Recife channel, who only wakes for those who come paddling from afar.

Rio abaixo, rio acima, a Boiúna vai nada.en:
Downriver and upriver, the Boiúna swims along,
with eyes like lantern lights, she guides the boatmen's song.
Whoever paddles patiently can hear the river breathe:
it's the great snake sleeping, waiting underneath.

Fala do gigante da mata funda, que anda.en: About the giant of the deep woods, who walks where the forest is oldest.

Tem um grito na mata que faz a onça cala.en:
A cry in the forest makes the jaguar still,
it's old Mapinguari walking slow up the hill.
He won't fell a young tree, won't harm a kind soul:
he shows up for those who hear their heart whole.

Fala da guardiã dos bichos que passou a.en: About the guardian of the animals who began to roam after the Cartel's lab fell.

Montada no queixada, a Caipora vem ligei.en:
Riding on her peccary, the Caipora rushes near,
she grabs the cruel hunter and sets the creatures clear.
Whoever hunts from malice will lose their way for good;
whoever guards the forest never walks alone in the wood.

Fala do pássaro cujo canto faz a mata in.en: About the bird whose song makes the whole forest stop to listen.

Quando canta o Uirapuru, a mata para de.en:
When the Uirapuru sings, the forest holds its tongue,
the river holds its water, the wind's song goes unsung.
They say it's lucky to hear one song alone:
whoever hears it twice will never be alone.

Fala da ave do trovão que mora nas nuven.en: About the thunderbird that lives in the clouds high on the mountain.

Lá no alto da serra, onde o céu faz trov.en:
High up on the mountain, where the sky rolls thunder down,
lives the Gavião-Tupã with lightning for a crown.
Each feather is a bolt, each cry a thunderclap:
only a calm heart can climb up to its lap.

Fala do lobo da lua e da onça do sol, qu.en: About the wolf of the moon and the jaguar of the sun, who only roam free after the Council of Guardians.

Jaci é a lua cheia, Guaraci é o sol nasc.en:
Jaci is the full moon, Guaraci the rising sun,
one's a wolf, one's a jaguar, among us both will run.
One appears at night, the other with the dawn:
beat the Council and you'll see the siblings dancing on.

ENXAME: {especie} aparece aos montes em.en: SWARM: {especie} is showing up in droves at {local} today.

SEXTA DA TARTARUGA: a Tartaruga-Gigante.en: TURTLE FRIDAY: Tartaruga-Gigante comes up to breathe at Recife Submerso, beneath Baía Azul. Today only!

TREINO DA RIVAL: a Tainá está na Gruta d.en: RIVAL TRAINING: Tainá is at Gruta do Eco, near the exit to Porto Sereia. One battle a day.

REVANCHES: ninguém da sua lista treina n.en: REMATCHES: no one on your list trains this {periodo}. Check the table under Rematches.

TORRE DE DESAFIOS: o Juiz da Torre esper.en: CHALLENGE TOWER: the Tower Judge is waiting at Platô da Liga. One battle a day, everyone at level 50.

QUIZ DA FAUNA: a Locutora Sabiá grava pe.en: FAUNA QUIZ: Announcer Sabiá records new questions today at Rádio Farol.

QUIZ DA FAUNA: acerte 4 de 5 perguntas n.en: FAUNA QUIZ: get 4 of 5 questions right at Rádio Farol, on Ilha do Farol, and win the Radio Card!

nas copas de Bosque Alto.en: in the treetops of Bosque Alto

no buritizal de Vila Buriti.en: in the buriti grove of Vila Buriti

na roda de capoeira da Cidade Ginga.en: at the capoeira roda in Cidade Ginga

na Gruta do Eco, perto da saída para Por.en: at Gruta do Eco, near the exit to Porto Sereia

Dezesseis insígnias, hein? Eu conto as m.en: Sixteen badges, huh? I count mine every Tuesday and Thursday down here. Today the cave's going to echo MY name!

Achou meu esconderijo! Terça e quinta eu.en: You found my hideout! Tuesdays and Thursdays I train here, in the dark, so nobody can copy me. One battle. Just one. It makes the day!

O eco repete \"perdeu, perdeu, perdeu\"….en: The echo keeps repeating "you lost, you lost, you lost"… Even the cave is cheering for you. Come back next training day!

A vereda já está pronta: buriti, capim e.en: The vereda's already done: buriti palms, grass and cerrado critters.

Pedra de rio! Com ela eu calço a margem.en: A river stone! With it I can line the bank and the lagoon will hold water all year round. Come back tomorrow… just kidding, it's ready!

Muda de buriti da Vila Buriti! Onde tem.en: A buriti sapling from Vila Buriti! Where there's buriti there's water, and where there's water the forest comes back. Go take a look: there's already a howler monkey yelling in there.

Um tronco oco inteirinho! É casa para co.en: A whole hollow log! It's a home for owls, potoos, anyone who likes the dark. The den is open, but careful: there's something big in there.

Na Torre todo mundo é nível 50. Aqui gan.en: In the Tower everyone is level 50. Here, whoever thinks best wins!

Pensou melhor mesmo. Até amanhã na Torre.en: You really did think better. See you tomorrow at the Tower!

Ai, que saudade de uma Cotiazinha! A min.en: Oh, how I miss having a Cotiazinha! Mine ran off after a palm nut and never came back. I've got a feisty Saguinho named Pipoca. Will you trade it for a Cotiazinha?

Sem Cotiazinha na equipe? Elas vivem no.en: No Cotiazinha on your team? They live in the understory of Mata dos Sabiás. Bring one, and Pipoca's ready to go!

Tudo bem… O Pipoca vai continuar rouband.en: That's okay… Pipoca will just keep stealing bananas from the fruit bowl.

Que lindeza! Cuida bem do Pipoca: ele ad.en: How lovely! Take good care of Pipoca: it loves cashews and squawks at hawks.

A Cotiazinha já enterrou três coquinhos.en: Cotiazinha has already buried three palm nuts in my backyard. There'll be coconut trees growing in the kitchen!

Psiu! Pescador velho não grita, que espa.en: Psst! An old fisher doesn't shout, it scares the fish. I miss having a Pipirim on my shoulder: it would tell me when the float moved. I've got Bigode, a Mandizinho I caught on a hook. It's a River type: pulls a canoe like a charm. Trade it for a Pipirim?

Pipirim, aquele passarinho de topete, vi.en: Pipirim, that little crested bird, lives in the grass of Trilha do Ipê and Campos de Restinga. Bring one on your team! And if you're in a hurry: with a rod, right here by the dock, you can catch a Piabinha. It's a River type too.

Tudo bem. Mas lembre: sem criatura de Ri.en: Okay. But without a River creature on your team, the Paddle won't budge.

Que topete bonito! O Bigode gosta de caj.en: What a pretty crest! Bigode likes cashew fruit and still water. With it on your team, the Paddle takes you to Baía Azul.

O Pipirim já avisou três fisgadas hoje..en: Pipirim has already called three bites today. Two were my boot. Still, it's a good helper.

Pescador sem caranguejo é que nem samba.en: A fisher without a crab is like samba without a tambourine! I need a Caranguejim for my seine net. In exchange I'll give you Marola, an Ariranhinha I found in the creek. Deal?

Caranguejim mora no mangue e na areia da.en: Caranguejim lives in the mangroves and on Baía Azul's sand. Bring one, and Marola waits.

Então a Marola fica comigo… e com os meu.en: Then Marola stays with me… and with my fish, unfortunately.

Trato feito! A Marola é brincalhona: mer.en: It's a deal! Marola is playful: dives, steals açaí and comes back laughing. Safe travels, you two!

O Caranguejim já é o capitão da rede. Pe.en: Caranguejim is already captain of the net. I caught twice as much this week!

Os cupins comeram a perna da minha banca.en: The termites ate the leg of my workbench… and I want a Cupinzim to study how they do it! In exchange I'll give you Trovoada, a Bugiozinho that hollers louder than my hammer.

Cupinzim vive no capim aqui da vila, per.en: Cupinzim lives in the grass here in the village, near the termite mounds. Bring one!

Pois bem. O Trovoada continua acordando.en: Very well. Trovoada will keep waking the village at five in the morning.

Negócio fechado! O Trovoada gosta de peq.en: Deal! Trovoada likes pequi and gusty winds. If it doesn't listen to you, it's still getting used to you.

O Cupinzim roeu a bancada nova também. E.en: Cupinzim chewed up the new workbench too. I'm learning a lot. And buying lots of wood.

Ah, não! Escapou da cuia!.en: Oh no! It broke free of the gourd!

Você se afastou devagarinho e deixou a c.en: You backed away slowly and left the creature in peace.

Sem Cuias-Safári, o passeio acaba aqui..en: No Safari Gourds left, so the outing ends here.

Você jogou uma isca de capim-doce. {nome.en: You tossed some sweetgrass bait. {nome} is eating!

Você jogou uma pedrinha. {nome} ficou br.en: You tossed a pebble. {nome} got angry!

Mais perto que isso, só fazendo carinho..en: Any closer and you'd be petting it.

Você chegou bem pertinho, sem fazer baru.en: You crept right up close, without a sound…

Você deu uns passos à frente, devagar….en: You took a few slow steps forward…

Apareceu no capim: {nome} selvagem!.en: Out of the grass: a wild {nome}!

Pedra de rio, lisinha, de correnteza. Um.en: A river stone, smooth from the current. A fisher on Trilha dos Cipós is always collecting pebbles by the river.

Muda de buriti. A viveirista de Vila Bur.en: A buriti sapling. The nursery keeper in Vila Buriti has a seedling bed near the gardens.

Tronco oco, caído e seco. O lenhador da.en: A hollow log, fallen and dry. The Estrada do Buriti woodcutter only cuts fallen trees.

Ora, visita! Eu sou o Jatobá. Comprei um.en: Well, a visitor! I'm Jatobá. I bought a worn-out pasture and I'm giving it back to the animals, one sector at a time.

A Vereda dos Buritis já está pronta. Par.en: Vereda dos Buritis is already done. For the other three sectors, I need materials you can only find around Costa do Sol.

O parque está completo: Vereda, Lagoa, M.en: The park is complete: Vereda, Lagoon, Forest and Den. You've made {n} partnerships here already. Thank you, Champion!

{objeto}? Guarde, que é para depois! Pri.en: {objeto}? Hold on to that, it's for later! First I need {proximo} for {setor}.

O próximo setor é {setor}. Para ele eu p.en: The next sector is {setor}. For it I need: {objeto}

A maquete do parque, de barro e palitinh.en:
The park model, made of clay and toothpicks:
{linhas}

CIMA/BAIXO ou toque na raia: trocar de r.en: UP/DOWN or tap a lane: switch lanes   B: give up

A ou toque: empurrar na faixa verde B:.en: A or tap: push on the green band   B: give up

A ou toque: pular B: desistir.en: A or tap: jump   B: give up

Desistir da prova? Os pontos desta rodad.en: Give up the trial? Points from this round won't count.
